summary: Diff adds an optional trackingNumber field to the backend Order type (with migration) and adds frontend support to set/display tracking numbers, plus a post-submit payment-instruction toast. However, the diff summary does not provide evidence that the required backend admin-only set/update method (with status gating) is implemented or that getOrder/getAllOrders definitely return the new field.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose optional tracking number via existing order query methods (getOrder, getAllOrders).
missing_requirements.reason: Although backend Order now includes trackingNumber, the diff excerpt of backend/main.mo is truncated before any getOrder/getAllOrders implementations, so there is no direct evidence those query methods return the new field.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; shows Order has trackingNumber but not getOrder/getAllOrders)

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an admin-only backend method to set/update an order tracking number, rejecting updates for pending orders and non-admin callers.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.setTrackingNumber(...) and a hook was added, but the diff summary does not show any corresponding backend function definition nor the required enforcement (admin-only + non-pending status). backend/main.mo is truncated before any such method is visible.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a backend migration module and enabled actor migration wiring.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not ask for a migration system/module explicitly; this is additional implementation beyond the stated requirements (though it supports REQ-1 compatibility).
